edges.effect_quant: The strongest quantitative studies point in a harmful direction, but the pooled magnitude varies across populations and methods.
edges.population: adults with suppressed TSH on levothyroxine
edges.mechanism: Excess thyroid hormone increases adrenergic sensitivity and atrial excitability, providing a straightforward mechanism for more atrial fibrillation when replacement overshoots.
edges.summary: The strongest piece here is the 2026 Cai meta analysis in Front Cardiovasc Med, which ties levothyroxine over- replacement to atrial fibrillation in a direction that later studies largely support. That makes this edge more about calibrating magnitude and context than arguing over whether the signal exists at all.
edges.caveats: Residual confounding and reverse causation remain possible in some observational studies, so the main readout is direction and plausibility rather than one exact risk number.
